postings.title: Account Manager
postings.description:
Who we are:

Our people are our greatest asset, and we are dedicated to fostering a positive culture where people are at the heart of everything we do. We believe in the power of collaboration and the importance of each team member in shaping our shared success. Our culture thrives on diversity, innovation, empowerment and progression. We live by our values and embrace creativity, using data driven insights and campaign effectiveness to deliver exceptional experiences for both our customers and our teams.

As an equal opportunity employer, we invest in our employees' development, prioritize their health and wellbeing, and nurture a culture that is ego free.

About the role:

We’re on the lookout for a driven and tenacious Account Manager to manage and grow a portfolio of clients. This role will see you drive new business opportunities by selling creative advertising solutions across our portfolio of out-of-home media assets. 

A Day in the Life:

• Work towards weekly KPI’s within your Sales Team 
• Maintain & achieve revenue performance requirements set out by GSM and Sales Director. 
• Constantly strive to achieve balanced exposure across the designated territory marketplace.
• Maintain high performance deadlines on response to brief.
• Work with your GSM to maintain high levels of engagements & new opportunities to market
• Maintain strategy documents, focusing on product revenue requirements 
• Educate clients with new products to market, short, medium and long-term product opportunities

About You: 

You’ll be someone with a demonstrated media sales background who enjoys working with agency clients and is motivated by driving business forward. You’ll be someone who thinks outside the box and enjoys seeking and winning new business by offering innovative and client focused solutions. As well as:

- Intermediate Microsoft Office skills - Outlook, Word, Excel and PowerPoint

- Be able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner; generates solutions

- High level of communication skills

- Ability to multitask

Why join JCDecaux:

At JCDecaux your wellbeing, health, and safety are our top priority. We value and reward your contributions and ensure Belonging and Inclusion are at the heart of everything we do.

Benefits on offer:

- Opportunity to get an additional week of annual leave after your first year (25 days), volunteer leave, and dedicated celebration and wellness days.

- Participation in our bonus or OTE programs

- Access to comprehensive training and development opportunities, including personalised development plans and a range of in-person and online courses to support your career journey. Development which enables you to advance and reach your full potential.

- Parental leave and Market-leading fertility leave.

- Fully supported hybrid working arrangements (subject to role).

- Opportunities to be part of employee-led steering committees across Diversity & Inclusion, Reconciliation Action Plan (RAP), Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) and Sustainability. Our dedicated DEIB committee champions are involved in initiatives like Pride Panel, International Women’s Day, and RAP. We also proudly partner with charities such as R U OK?, Oz Harvest, and Thread Together.

Join us and be part of a company where your ideas matter, your growth is a priority, and your contributions will help us lead the way in transforming the Out-of-Home landscape.

postings.description:
THE COMPANY

JCDecaux is the number 1 outdoor advertising company in the world, playing a major part in transforming urban landscapes across the globe. As the premium broadcast supplier in Out-of-Home media; JCDecaux is the only pure-play Outdoor media owner worldwide, delivering high-quality and innovative advertising solutions.

We understand that people are our biggest asset. By offering exceptional experiences and accelerating the investment and development of our employees and ensuring we prioritize their health and well-being, we are working together to achieve our vision to be the unrivalled out-of-home leader in Australia and New Zealand, delivering exceptional experiences for brands, partners and our people.

THE OPPORTUNITY

Here you’ll be joining a fast paced, high performing, collaborative team providing sales service to the designated groups of clients and agencies. Working closely with your GSM, you’ll manage proactive sales conversations, respond to briefs, as well as instigating new partnerships.

- Work towards weekly KPI’s within your Sales Team

- Maintain & achieve revenue performance requirements set out by GSM and GBD.

- Constantly strive to achieve balanced exposure across the designated territory marketplace.

- Maintain high performance deadlines on response to brief.

- Work with your GSM to maintain high levels of engagements & new opportunities to market

- Maintain strategy documents, focusing on product revenue requirements

- Educate clients with new products to market, short, medium and long-term product opportunities

TO BE SUCCESSFUL:

You’ll be someone with prior media experience, whether it be media agency or media sales. You’ll be motivated by driving business, growing relationships and providing exceptional support. As well as:

- Possess excellent attention to detail

- Intermediate Microsoft Office Skills

- Be able to identify and resolve problems in a timely manner; generate solutions

- High level of communication skills

- Ability to multitask

postings.title: End User Support
postings.description:
About the role:

As End User Support, you’ll be the first point of contact of our IT service, responding to support requests, logging and tracking incidents, and providing basic technical assistance across hardware, software and connectivity issues.

You’ll focus on delivering an exceptional customer experience, resolving immediate issues where you can, and efficiently escalating more complex problems to our specialist IT teams in Australia and France. This role is highly customer‑facing and ideal for someone passionate about technology and keen to build a career in IT support.

A Day in the Life:

Whilst there’s no typical day in the dynamic world of media, you can expect your role to involve the following:

- Act as the first point of contact for IT support, answering incoming requests via phone, email, chat and the self‑service portal in a timely, professional and courteous manner.

- Log, categorise and prioritise all IT incidents and service requests in the IT Service Management (ITSM) system (e.g. ManageEngine), keeping end‑users informed of progress and managing expectations until issues are fully resolved.

- Provide first‑line troubleshooting for common issues, including basic hardware (monitors, keyboards, mice, docking stations), standard software (Microsoft Office, web browsers), local network connectivity (e.g. Wi‑Fi) and local printing/scanning.

- Escalate more complex technical problems to Tier 2/Tier 3 or specialised teams, ensuring all troubleshooting steps are documented and logging issues with corporate IT teams in Australia and France as required (e.g. Active Directory, Microsoft licensing, server management).

- Support IT processes and documentation by contributing to the IT knowledge base (common fixes, FAQs, step‑by‑step guides) and assisting with IT inventory tracking, such as newly deployed and returned laptops.

- Collaborate with the wider IT team, demonstrating a positive, customer‑focused mindset, learning from senior technicians and contributing to a supportive, high‑performing team environment.

About You:

You’re customer‑focused and patient, with a genuine desire to help people and a strong interest in technology. You’re comfortable communicating clearly with non‑technical users and enjoy solving problems.

You’ll bring:

- Strong commitment to providing a positive, empathetic and patient customer experience.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain basic technical concepts to non‑technical users.

- Familiarity with Windows and/or macOS operating systems, standard office software, and basic computer hardware components.

- Strong analytical skills with a logical approach to diagnosing issues and finding solutions.

- Ability to multitask, prioritise a busy queue of incoming requests, and manage your time effectively.

Preferred (but not required):

- Previous experience in a customer service or call centre environment.

- An IT‑related diploma, certificate, or currently pursuing an IT degree.

- Familiarity with IT ticketing or ITSM software.

Why join JCDecaux:

At JCDecaux your wellbeing, health, and safety are our top priority. We value and reward your contributions and ensure Belonging and Inclusion are at the heart of everything we do.

Benefits on offer:

- Opportunity to get an additional week of annual leave after your first year (25 days), volunteer leave, and dedicated celebration and wellness days.

- Participation in our bonus or OTE programs

- Access to comprehensive training and development opportunities, including personalised development plans and a range of in-person and online courses to support your career journey. Development which enables you to advance and reach your full potential.

postings.title: National Development Manager (12 month contract)
postings.description:
About the role:

The role of National Development Manager provides a unique career combination of both property and media industry sectors. It will see you manage and implement the development of large format media assets. Working across multi-disciplined consultant teams that include Town Planners, Architects and other town planning specialists, as well as direct engagement with key contract partners across State and Local Government. 

A Day in the Life:

Whilst there’s no typical day in the dynamic world of media, you can expect your role to involve the following:

- Manage existing contract relationships.

- Development of new and redevelopment of existing large format out-of-home media assets

- Have and maintain a strong general knowledge of State and Local government town planning legislation as it relates to out-of–home media.

- Assist the broader commercial function in preparing development related tender documentation and presentations to existing and prospective clients.

- Establish an ongoing positive relationship with State and Local government.

- Visit and present JCDecaux’s development concepts to State and Local government.

- Stay informed of new town planning or related laws, codes and standards related to out-of-home media.

- As required, represent JCDecaux on the Outdoor Media Associations (OMA) regulatory affairs committee.

- Monitor and understand planning schemes for all JCDecaux related Councils.

- As required review (Outdoor Media Association) OMA town planning reports for any changes which may affect potential JCDecaux future contract areas.

- Manage the preparation and delivery of monthly, quarterly and annual development related reports

About You:

You’ll ideally come from a Town Planning background or have demonstrated experience within property or relevant industry within Government or private sector. You’ll be someone with exceptional attention to detail, strong communication skills and a real team player. In addition to:

- Degree Qualified in Town Planning, Architecture, Urban Design, Property or closely related discipline.

- Knowledge of local and State government processes

- Be highly skilled in all administrative tasks.

- IT literate in Excel, MS word and related project management software programs.

- Be capable of concurrently managing a wide range of tasks and priorities while maintaining a highly professional approach.

- Be able to communicate and work effectively with stakeholders to achieve common objectives.

postings.description:
About the role:

As our Test Analyst, you will play a hands-on role in planning, coordinating and executing software testing activities across critical business platforms.

Working closely with developers, business analysts, project managers and business stakeholders, you will help ensure that software releases meet agreed quality, functionality, performance and usability standards. Identifying and investigating defects, validate solutions, support release readiness and contribute to continuous improvements in testing practices.

A Day in the Life:

Whilst there’s no typical day in the dynamic world of media, you can expect your role to involve the following:

- Develop and maintain test strategies, test plans, test scenarios and test cases.

- Review business and technical requirements to ensure they are complete, clear and testable.

- Plan and manage testing sprints in Jira, including test activities, case allocation, timelines and milestones.

- Execute manual functional, regression, integration, system, user acceptance, data validation and exploratory testing.

- Validate data flows, interfaces, reports, integrations, business rules and system outputs.

- Maintain traceability between requirements, test cases, test results and defects.

- Support release testing, production readiness assessments and go-live activities.

- Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes, tools, standards and documentation.

About You:

You will be an analytical and detail-focused Test Analyst who takes ownership of delivering high-quality outcomes. You will bring:

- A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.

- Experience in a software testing or quality assurance role.

- A strong understanding of software development and testing life cycles.

- Strong defect investigation, troubleshooting and problem-solving capabilities.

- Excellent analytical and critical-thinking skills, with exceptional attention to detail.
